items.exampleEn: Every morning, the children trek two kilometers through the fields to school.
items.exampleZh: 孩子們每天早上要走兩公里穿過田野去上學。

items.exampleEn: The motorist stopped his car to let a family of ducks cross the road.
items.exampleZh: 那位汽車駕駛人停下車，讓一家子鴨子過馬路。

items.exampleEn: The city painted green lanes on the roads to protect cyclists.
items.exampleZh: 市政府在路上漆了綠色車道來保護騎單車的人。

items.exampleEn: Runners must pass five checkpoints before they reach the finish line.
items.exampleZh: 跑者到達終點前必須通過五個檢查站。

items.exampleEn: A long caravan of cars and buses carried the fans to the concert.
items.exampleZh: 一長列汽車和巴士組成的車隊，載著歌迷前往演唱會。
items.glossZh: （車、馬等的）隊伍；商隊；（英）露營車

items.exampleEn: The fishermen threw the small fish overboard and kept the big ones.
items.exampleZh: 漁夫們把小魚丟回海裡，大魚則留下來。

items.exampleEn: At the airport, I put my two heavy suitcases on a trolley.
items.exampleZh: 在機場，我把兩個重行李箱放上推車。

items.exampleEn: My scooter broke down, so I took the bus to work.
items.exampleZh: 我的機車拋錨了，所以我搭公車上班。

items.sentenceEn: Don't go overboard with the decorations; the party is only for six people.
items.sentenceZh: 裝飾別弄得太誇張，派對只有六個人。

items.audioEn: Motorists should use the bridge today because the tunnel is closed for repairs.
items.audioZh: 隧道今天封閉維修，駕駛人應改走那座橋。
items.questionZh: 隧道今天為什麼不能走？

items.sentenceEn: We trekked for six hours to reach the lake in the mountains.
items.sentenceZh: 我們跋涉了六個小時，才到達山裡的那座湖。

items.sentenceEn: The woman pushed a shopping trolley full of fruit to her car.
items.sentenceZh: 那位女士推著一台裝滿水果的購物車走向她的車。

items.stemEn: The guards at the ____ checked every truck before it crossed the bridge.
items.stemZh: 檢查站的守衛在每輛卡車過橋前都會檢查。

items.stemEn: A ____ was riding so fast down the hill that he nearly hit a bus.
items.stemZh: 一位騎單車的人下坡騎得太快，差點撞上公車。

items.passageEn: Last year, my cousin joined a two-week trek in the mountains of Nepal. Each morning, the group walked with a caravan of horses that carried their tents and food. Along the way, they passed several checkpoints where guides checked their papers. In one village, everyone got around by scooter or on foot, because there were no cars. On a boat trip across a lake, my cousin's hat flew overboard, and the man driving the boat laughed. When she came home, she said motorists and cyclists in the city seemed to be in a hurry all the time, unlike the calm villagers.
items.passageZh: 去年，我表姊參加了尼泊爾山區為期兩週的徒步旅行。每天早上，團員們跟著一隊載著帳篷和食物的馬匹一起走。一路上，他們經過好幾個檢查站，嚮導會在那裡檢查他們的證件。在一個村子裡，大家都騎機車或走路，因為那裡沒有汽車。搭船渡湖時，表姊的帽子飛到船外，開船的人笑了。回家後，她說城裡的駕駛人和騎單車的人好像總是很匆忙，不像那些悠閒的村民。

questions.questionZh: 表姊回家後覺得城裡的人怎麼樣？

items.promptZh: 很多年輕人騎機車上學。
referenceEn: Many young people ride scooters to school.
A lot of young people go to school by scooter.
rubricZh: scooter 指機車（例如 ride scooters、by scooter）

items.instructionZh: 用 trek 造一個句子，說說你走過的一段很長的路或想去的徒步旅行。
referenceEn: I'd love to go on a trek through the forests of the east coast.
Last summer, I trekked up a mountain with my friends for two days.
rubricZh: 句子要用到 trek（名詞或動詞皆可）

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 第②關 issue 結案：釋義與例句用法不合：例句 "a long caravan of cars and buses"（中譯「車隊」）示範的是「一長列車隊」義，釋義「旅行隊；商隊；（英）露營車」沒涵蓋；建議例句改成駱駝／馬匹商隊，或釋義補「（一列）車隊」。另干擾項「船隊」與「車隊」語義相近，易混。
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 已修正：見本檔 resolvedAfterFinalReview 中 items/4 的 2 筆修正紀錄。
